summary: The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that are designed to provide, in the aggregate, 200% exposure to the price performance of BRR on a daily basis. The fund may also seek to achieve its investment objective by purchasing call options on RDW or by investing directly in the common stock of RDW. The fund is non-diversified.
